confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates, not checked against live listings or menus. Restaurant anchors are more reliable than accommodation, which varies widely by season and Turkish lira volatility. The FX observation comes from a search summary of the RBA overview page; I did not open the page or the F11 table directly.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on Mediterranean and Aegean Turkish resort towns with similar tourist pricing (for example Bodrum, Fethiye and Antalya), adjusted for Turkey-wide restaurant price levels. Turkey is transcontinental, so Europe is used here as the regional bucket.
